item.title: Command-Line Banner Generation Tool - pyfiglet
item.description: 1. What Is pyfiglet pyfiglet is an ASCII art text generation tool implemented in Python. It can generate graphics like the following from a string: 1 2 3 4 5 6 _ _ _ _ _ _ | |__ ___| | | ___ __ _____ _ __| | __| | | | '_ \ / _ \ | |/ _ \ \ \ /\ / / _ \| '__| |/ _` | | | | | | __/ | | (_) | \ V V / (_) | | | | (_| |_| |_| |_|\___|_|_|\___( ) \_/\_/ \___/|_| |_|\__,_(_) |/ When writing CLI tools, you can use pyfiglet to generate a Banner to display on the command line.

item.title: The manage Command in Django
